profile.headline: .NET Developer | Software Developer
profile.summary:
• Software Developer with 4 years of design and programming experience working with ASP.NET MVC, C#, WCF Services, Web Forms, Razor Views, LINQ, .NET Framework, IIS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, Bootstrap, AngularJS 1.X.
• Working experience in Developing, enhancing, and troubleshooting complex .NET Web Applications using Microsoft Technologies Stack. 
• Strong Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming concepts, SOLID Design Principles.
• Actively participated in all stages of Software Development Life Cycle from user requirements to writing technical design documents, development, testing, deployment and production support.
• Excellent Team Player with good problem solving, strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Effective in working independently and collaboratively in teams and the ability to handle multiple projects.

positions.title: Web Application Developer and Classroom Learning Assistant
positions.description:
Project Name: ATOM (Athletic Trainer Outcome Monitoring) designed to demonstrate the significant impact Athletic Trainers have on the health, wellbeing, and function of the injured athletes they care for on a daily basis.
Website URL: https://atom.nata.org

Responsibilities included: -

• Worked as Web Application Developer for University project ATOM (Athletic Trainer Outcome Monitoring) using Front End Technologies like HTML 5, CSS 3, JavaScript, jQuery, Angular JS 1.5, Bootstrap to design interfaces and developed back end using ASP.NET C#, Web Forms, and SQL Server 2014 r2.
• Extensively used JavaScript and jQuery manipulate DOM elements, Event handling, form validations.
• Used AngularJS as a framework to create a Single Page Application (SPA).
• Worked with Angular JS Controllers, Models, Views, Modules, services, Directives, Route Configuration, Filters and CRUD operations.
• Used ui-router for configuring UI routes to achieve state routing.
• Extensively used jQuery Grid which provides easy searching, paging and sorting functionalities and RESTful API to access data from the specific end-point.
• Participated in weekly meetings related to Web development progress and future planning.
• Worked as a Classroom Learning Assistant for VB.NET and Dynamic Web Page Development. Assisted students having difficulties in their projects.
• Technologies: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Angular JS, Microsoft Visual Studio 2015, SQL server 2014 R2, .NET framework 4.5, ASP.NET, C#, WebStorm.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Project Name: Web recruits -Developed an application using ASP.NET 3- Layer architecture that administered live interviews, prerecorded interviews, and online assessment tests for the recruiting process. The website also allows users to view job vacancies available within the different departments, exchange messages, send notifications and view reports.
Website URL: http://wingsts.com:2323/Login.aspx

•Developed enterprise web applications using JavaScript, Angular JS 1.4, JQuery, HTML5, CSS 2.1, .Net framework 4.5, C# Programming, ASP.NET, Web Forms, and SQL server 2014 R2.
•Provided UI design for the application using HTML5, CSS3 JavaScript, Angular JS, JQuery and Bootstrap CSS. 
•Designed User Interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery and Mobile First Cross-Device responsive web design Bootstrap Framework.
•Worked with web service to get data from the database and Consume it using AngularJS $http Service.
•Extensively used ADO.NET Components such as DataSets, Data Adapters, Data Readers and Data Tables to retrieve data from the SQL Server Database and display it into Data GridView and DataRepeater.
•Worked with Server-Side, Client-Side Validation, Default Validation controls like and Custom Validator.
•Wrote SQL queries for creating views, stored procedures and copying data from one table to temporary table in SQL Server. Used joins, unions to get data from different tables and databases.
•Used Query String, Session Variables, and cookies to store and transfer data from one page to another.
•Diagnose and resolve bugs in an efficient and effective manner using Visual studio default debugger and browsers debugging Tools and come up with solutions.
•Participated in Project coordination, Design discussion, implementation, and planning.
•Build a strong relationship and influence on team members.
•Technologies: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript,  Angular JS, JQuery, Microsoft Visual Studio 2012, SQL server 2008 R2, .NET Framework 4.0, ASP.NET, C#, WebStorm.

projects.title: Landlord Tenant Rating System
projects.description:
•This system was developed as a final project in my master’s program. The system provides a comprehensive way for landlords to post properties and tenants to rate them. 
•Technologies used: ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server 2008, HTML, CSS, JAVA Script, Bootstrap, Microsoft Visual Studio 2015.

projects.title: SHU Game Project
projects.description: SHU Virtual Tour Game – It is the game to visit the whole campus of Sacred Heart University. You can get some points when you enter some buildings and grab the monsters. I Worked on a C# Script to manage a Game Score, Level Management and Game Ending. We use .NET framework 4.5 to write C# Script. I implemented code for an automatic Sliding Doors by using invisible triggers ,Level management and Scoring System.
